Third-party code inside the Qt 6.12.0 libraries bundled with Leafweaving
=======================================================================

Qt is Copyright (C) The Qt Company Ltd. and other contributors, used under the
GNU LGPL-3.0 (see LGPL-3.0.txt / GPL-3.0.txt in the parent folder).

The Qt libraries themselves contain the third-party code listed below.  The
data comes from Qt's own qt_attribution.json files (attribution/*.json, taken
from qtbase at tag v6.12.0); the license texts referenced by SPDX id are in
license-texts/.  Components are listed if they can be compiled into the Qt
modules Leafweaving ships (QtCore, QtGui, QtWidgets, QtNetwork, QtPrintSupport,
QtDBus and the platform plugins); which ones are present depends on the
operating system build.


BLAKE2 (reference implementation)  [blake2]
  License:   CC0-1.0 OR Apache-2.0   (version ed1974ea83433eba7b2d95c5dcd9ac33cb847913)
  Homepage:  https://blake2.net/
  Copyright: Copyright 2012, Samuel Neves <sneves@dei.uc.pt>
  Used in:   Used in Qt Core (QCryptographicHash).

Efficient Binary-Decimal and Decimal-Binary Conversion Routines for IEEE Doubles  [doubleconversion]
  License:   BSD-3-Clause   (version 3.4.0)
  Homepage:  https://github.com/google/double-conversion
  Copyright: Copyright 2006-2012, the V8 project authors
  Used in:   Used in Qt Core. Configure with -system-doubleconversion or -no-doubleconversion to avoid.

Easing Equations by Robert Penner  [easing]
  License:   BSD-3-Clause
  Homepage:  http://robertpenner.com/easing/
  Copyright: Copyright (c) 2001 Robert Penner
  Used in:   Used in Qt Core (QEasingCurve).

Emoji Segmenter  [emoji-segmenter]
  License:   Apache-2.0   (version 0.4.0)
  Homepage:  https://github.com/google/emoji-segmenter
  Copyright: Copyright 2019 Google LLC
  Used in:   Used in QtGui for parsing complex emoji sequences. Can be configured using the -emojisegmenter option.

The Public Suffix List  [psl-data]
  License:   MPL-2.0   (version 2026-05-14_08-35-31_UTC)
  Homepage:  http://publicsuffix.org/
  Copyright: The list was originally provided by Jo Hermans <jo.hermans@gmail.com>.
It is now maintained on github (https://github.com/publicsuffix/list).
  Used in:   Used in Qt Network to avoid setting "supercookies" in the cookie jar
supported by Qt (by the QNetworkCookieJar class).

libpsl - C library to handle the Public Suffix List  [libpsl]
  License:   BSD-3-Clause   (version 664f3dc85259ec65e30248a61fa1c45b7b0e4c3f)
  Homepage:  https://github.com/rockdaboot/libpsl
  Copyright: Copyright 2014-2016 The Chromium Authors. All rights reserved.
  Used in:   Used to compress the embedded copy of publicsuffix list and
to lookup entries in it.

    Copyright (C) 2006 Peter Hutterer

  Used in:   Used in XCB platform plugin if xcb-xinput was not present on the system
